mapper.select: select t.id as topic_id, case when content_role.entity_type = 'PLATFORM' then '官方' when content_role.entity_type = 'CLUB' then coalesce(nullif(content_club.name, ''), '俱乐部信息待确认') when content_role.entity_type = 'MEMBER' then coalesce(nullif(content_member.nickname, ''), '会员信息待确认') when content_role.id is null then null else '主体待确认' end as content_publisher_name, case when content_role.entity_type = 'CLUB' then nullif(content_club.leader_name, '') else null end as content_publisher_leader_name, coalesce(club_apply.pending_club_application_count, 0) as pending_club_application_count, coalesce(club_invite.pending_club_invite_count, 0) as pending_club_invite_count, coalesce(cooperation.signed_club_cooperation_count, 0) as signed_club_cooperation_count, coalesce(lead_session.active_lead_session_count, 0) as active_lead_session_count, coalesce(candidate.candidate_count, 0) as candidate_count, coalesce(candidate.pending_candidate_count, 0) as pending_candidate_count, coalesce(candidate.approved_candidate_count, 0) as approved_candidate_count, coalesce(candidate.awarded_candidate_count, 0) as awarded_candidate_count, coalesce(cooperation.merchant_cooperation_count, 0) as merchant_cooperation_count, coalesce(active_offer.active_offer_count, 0) as active_offer_count, coalesce(chapter_supply.chapter_count, 0) as chapter_count, coalesce(chapter_supply.chapter_without_node_count, 0) as chapter_without_node_count, coalesce(chapter_supply.required_chapter_count, 0) as required_chapter_count, coalesce(chapter_supply.supplied_required_chapter_count, 0) as supplied_required_chapter_count, coalesce(chapter_supply.missing_required_chapter_count, 0) as missing_required_chapter_count, coalesce(ticket.ticket_count, 0) as ticket_count, coalesce(ticket.guided_ticket_count, 0) as guided_ticket_count, ticket.min_ticket_price as min_ticket_price, coalesce(ticket.total_ticket_inventory, 0) as total_ticket_inventory, coalesce(ticket.remaining_ticket_inventory, 0) as remaining_ticket_inventory, coalesce(registration.paid_registration_count, 0) as paid_registration_count, coalesce(registration.verified_head_count, 0) as verified_head_count, coalesce(registration.total_sales, 0) as total_sales, coalesce(registration.verified_sales, 0) as verified_sales, coalesce(registration.self_play_pass_occupied_count, 0) as self_play_pass_occupied_count, coalesce(settlement.pending_settlement_count, 0) as pending_settlement_count, coalesce(complaint.open_complaint_count, 0) as open_complaint_count from cms_topic t left join product_role content_role on content_role.topic_id = t.id and content_role.slot = 'CONTENT' and content_role.status = 1 left join club content_club on content_role.entity_type = 'CLUB' and content_club.id = content_role.entity_id and content_club.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member content_member on content_role.entity_type = 'MEMBER' and content_member.id = content_role.entity_id and content_member.del_flag = 0 left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as pending_club_application_count from coop_club_apply where del_flag = 0 and status = 0 and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) club_apply on club_apply.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as pending_club_invite_count from coop_invite where del_flag = 0 and status = 0 and to_type = 'club' and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) club_invite on club_invite.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, sum(case when to_type = 'club' then 1 else 0 end) as signed_club_cooperation_count, sum(case when to_type = 'merchant' then 1 else 0 end) as merchant_cooperation_count from coop_order where del_flag = 0 and status = 0 and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) cooperation on cooperation.topic_id = t.id left join ( select ca.topic_id, count(distinct ca.id) as active_lead_session_count from cms_activity ca inner join club lead_club on lead_club.id = ca.club_id and lead_club.del_flag = 0 inner join club_lead_state cls on cls.activity_id = ca.id and cls.status in (1, 2) where ca.del_flag = 0 and ca.topic_id in #{topicId} and exists ( select 1 from coop_order lead_cooperation where lead_cooperation.topic_id = ca.topic_id and lead_cooperation.to_type = 'club' and lead_cooperation.to_id = ca.club_id and lead_cooperation.status = 0 and lead_cooperation.del_flag = 0 ) group by ca.topic_id ) lead_session on lead_session.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as candidate_count, sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as pending_candidate_count, sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as approved_candidate_count, sum(case when audit_status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as awarded_candidate_count from cms_registration_merchant where del_flag = 0 and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) candidate on candidate.topic_id = t.id left join ( select chapter.topic_id, count(*) as chapter_count, sum(case when not exists ( select 1 from cms_topic_node node where node.chapter_id = chapter.id ) then 1 else 0 end) as chapter_without_node_count, sum(case when chapter.required = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as required_chapter_count, sum(case when chapter.required = 1 and ( select count(*) from merchant_chapter_offer offer where offer.topic_id = chapter.topic_id and offer.chapter_id = chapter.id and offer.status = 1 and (offer.valid_end is null or offer.valid_end > now()) ) >= greatest(coalesce(nullif(chapter.max_merchant, 0), 1), 1) then 1 else 0 end) as supplied_required_chapter_count, sum(case when chapter.required = 1 and ( select count(*) from merchant_chapter_offer offer where offer.topic_id = chapter.topic_id and offer.chapter_id = chapter.id and offer.status = 1 and (offer.valid_end is null or offer.valid_end > now()) ) < greatest(coalesce(nullif(chapter.max_merchant, 0), 1), 1) then 1 else 0 end) as missing_required_chapter_count from cms_topic_chapter chapter where chapter.topic_id in #{topicId} group by chapter.topic_id ) chapter_supply on chapter_supply.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as active_offer_count from merchant_chapter_offer where status = 1 and (valid_end is null or valid_end > now()) and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) active_offer on active_offer.topic_id = t.id left join ( select owner_id as topic_id, count(*) as ticket_count, sum(case when mode = 1 and (sub_type is null or lower(sub_type) != 'self') then 1 else 0 end) as guided_ticket_count, min(price) as min_ticket_price, sum(coalesce(total_inventory, 0)) as total_ticket_inventory, sum(coalesce(remaining_inventory, 0)) as remaining_ticket_inventory from oms_ticket where owner_type = 1 and del_flag = 0 and owner_id in #{topicId} group by owner_id ) ticket on ticket.topic_id = t.id left join ( select owner_id as topic_id, sum(case when payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as paid_registration_count, count(distinct case when payment_status = 2 and verification_status = 1 then member_id end) as verified_head_count, sum(case when payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 then payable_amount else 0 end) as total_sales, sum(case when payment_status = 2 and verification_status = 1 then payable_amount else 0 end) as verified_sales, sum(case when registration_status in (1, 2) and (purchase_kind = 2 or (purchase_kind is null and ticket_id is null and expires_at is not null)) then 1 else 0 end) as self_play_pass_occupied_count from cms_registration where owner_type = 1 and owner_id in #{topicId} group by owner_id ) registration on registration.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as pending_settlement_count from coop_settlement where del_flag = 0 and status = 0 and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) settlement on settlement.topic_id = t.id left join ( select topic_id, count(*) as open_complaint_count from coop_complaint where del_flag = 0 and status < 3 and topic_id in #{topicId} group by topic_id ) complaint on complaint.topic_id = t.id where t.id in #{topicId}
